selection_rule: Use the first frozen margin whose D8 upstream catchment from the frozen Corrales outlet does not touch the DEM crop boundary.
outlet_mapping_rule: Map the frozen accepted outlet spatial coordinate to the containing 30 m grid cell at each margin and require cell-center distance <= one DEM-cell diagonal.
source_integrity_rule: Any Copernicus tile shared with the outlet diagnostic must reproduce its persisted SHA256 exactly.
hydrologic_identity_rule: The polygon represents the Corrales drainage supplying the Rayos de Sol territorial target. It must not be relabeled as a standalone Rayos de Sol basin unless independent pre-unblind evidence contradicts the frozen Corrales identity.
